qs.q: Baroreceptors located in the carotid sinus and aortic arch respond primarily to which of the following?
o: C. Changes in arterial blood pressure
A. Changes in blood oxygen levels
D. Changes in blood glucose levels
B. Changes in blood acidity levels
qs.e: Baroreceptors are mechanoreceptors that detect stretch in the arterial walls caused by changes in blood pressure. They are most sensitive to changes in arterial blood pressure (B), specifically the rate of change and the mean arterial pressure.
